entries.title: Jan 5 — Takino Snow World: snow play & conditional tubing
entries.description: Proposed January 5, 2027 for Gustavo and Camilla (2 adults) at Takino Snow World, inside Takino Suzuran Hillside National Park. Admission plus available tubing/plastic-sled rental costs ¥0 TOTAL for two adults; transport, meals and any other paid rentals excluded. Allow 2–3 hours on site as a flexible planning estimate, not an official tour duration; allow additional return travel/waits. Namboku subway to Makomanai, then Chuo bus 真106 to Suzuran Park Higashiguchi (East Entrance); published vehicle times from Sapporo Station are about 18 minutes subway + 32 minutes bus each way, excluding waits/walking. January 2027 winter timetable/fares are not confirmed (current park timetable is summer 2026). IMPORTANT: the full 200-m tubing course usually opens late January onward; do not assume availability January 5. Check snow/open areas first; other snow play/forest walks are conditional. January 3 is dinner only because expected hotel arrival is around 19:00. No booking made. Official information checked October 24, 2026. Map pin is the official broad park anchor, not the East Entrance or tubing start; use the East Entrance transit instruction above.
